question: In a certain code language, R is written as 9, C is written as 24 and E is written as 22. How will RECITE be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/094413ca23e189e59a3d82079258703e8647a6aa49a3c37196c6d31304d23587.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

 
• R is written as 9, C is written as 24, and E is written as 22, which means the place value of the opposite letter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b90fa8789c83556886c2f559195a5b998f08cacab4c0cbe85b39297105a32e04.png] 

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.
